item.title: USDOL finds San Bernardino roofing, painting contractor denied employees overtime pay
item.description: SAN BERNARDINO, Ca. (USDOL) — The U.S. Department of Labor has found a San Bernardino roofing and painting contractor denied 62 employees pay for some of their hours worked, a violation of federal wage laws. item.title: Trump orders ‘blockade’ of sanctioned oil tankers leaving, entering Venezuela
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — President Donald Trump ordered on Tuesday a "blockade" of all sanctioned oil tankers entering and leaving Venezuela, in Washington's latest move to increase pressure on Nicolas Maduro's government, targeting its main source of income. The post Trump orders ‘blockade’ of sanctioned oil tankers leaving, entering Venezuela appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Jimmy Lai remains beacon of Hong Kong press freedom, say ex-colleagues awaiting his sentencing
item.description: HONG KONG/TAIPEI (Reuters) — Several former colleagues of Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai at the Apple Daily newspaper reacted with dismay at his national security conviction, fearing Lai and other former staffers may be given a heavy sentence but saying he remains an inspiration.
